# Card body



<!-- Auto Generated Below -->


## Overview

The card-body is a subcomponent of `wcs-card`. It represents content of the card with an extra padding around.

## Slots

| Slot        | Description                                                                                                                                                                            |
| ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `"default"` | Default slot for the card body content. You can put anything you want. If you want a structured card, you can use `wcs-card-header`, `wcs-card-content`, and `wcs-card-footer` as slot |
